events.title: Demo update v0.210: Choosing the party leader
events.summary: The Party leaderYou now name who leads a party, on the Send-Off tab, or let them settle it among themselves. The default is that they settle it. Standing decides who they would pick: bonds with the party present, years at your hall, veterancy, and traits. It is not Leadership, so a five-star newcomer can be a poor leader of four veterans.Naming a leader the party will not have costs you. events.summary: The Fog: a new way to found a guildA new option when you found, beside Ironman and Power Fantasy. Trust your readers. Learn your people by watching them. Unticked, you play with full knowledge, exactly as before. In the Fog you never see your delvers' true numbers. events.title: A Message from the Designer: the Demo Arrives 14 September
